rig.network: full-service firmware, clean unprovisioned AP; no station/broker credentials
rig.observer: USB STATUS 20 Hz; filtered temperature every 2 s

acceptance.order: AB, BA, AB, BA, AB; case order reverses in even pairs
acceptance.endurance_scope: Same 200-pixel mixed and fixed-Stars/background scenes as primary animation lane; five-second warmup and 60-second measured blocks with periodic replacement/brightness changes.
acceptance.endurance_disposition: Full hour cancelled at explicit user request; completed short windows retained, cleanup verified. No overnight automation scheduled.

limits: First baseline windows overlapped the Pico cross-build; later windows run without compilation. Keep host scheduling variation in the interpretation.
Full metadata polling produced observed ingress gaps in retained screening attempts. Filtered monitoring is a separately identified observer on both accepted-run groups.
Authenticated loaded-network/HA, physical output waveform/optical validation and physical USB unplug/replug are not established by these USB runs.
